weighin.title: The weigh-in gate
weighin.body: The app stays locked each morning until today's weight is in, then asks for a progress photo and shows the morning brief. The weight can come straight from a Eufy smart scale over Bluetooth: the app reads the scale's broadcasts and only accepts a reading once the scale marks it as settled, or it can be typed. The wake alarm keeps ringing until you weigh in or scan a barcode, so it can't be snoozed from bed.

today.title: The day's card
today.body: Today shows what's on now, a countdown to what's next and three buttons: Done, Skip and Snooze. A skip needs a reason, missed tasks turn red, and the wind-down makes you close out anything still open. Tasks, times, one-offs, checklists and targets are all edited inside the app, so a routine change never needs a rebuild.

streak.title: The streak
streak.body: A day counts when at least 80% of the plan is done and every non-negotiable is ticked; the threshold is a setting. Each counted day rolls the streak on, and a failed day resets it unless a streak save covers it: one save is earned every 14 counted days, and you can hold two. Past days are frozen into history after two days, so editing the routine can't rewrite the streak.

levers.title: Non-negotiables
levers.body: Any task can be marked non-negotiable, and by default waking up, the prepped lunch and the wind-down are. Missing one stops the day counting whatever the percentage. They carry a padlock in the timeline, and their reminders nag twice as often.

food.title: Food and meal prep
food.body: Calories and protein are tracked against targets you set yourself, from a barcode scan, a food search or a one-tap usual; only the barcode number or the search words ever leave the phone. Prepped lunch boxes are counted as stock. A library of 50 high-protein batch recipes fills four boxes each: pick two a week and the app builds one combined Aldi list, then a Cook both mode runs the two recipes with a labelled timer for every wait.

coach.title: The coach
coach.body: Reminders use exact alarms: a full-screen wake alarm, nag repeats when a task is ignored, and a pinned Now / Next notification with a Done button that survives a restart. The default tone is firm, blunt about behaviour, data and excuses but never about the person or their body; after a missed day the morning brief says never miss twice. A gentler tone is one switch away.

phone.title: Built for the Fold
phone.body: A native Android app for a Galaxy Z Fold, specified by Kaif and built with Claude, used every day. Folded, it's one column with a bottom tab bar; unfolded, the tabs become a side rail with today's timeline beside the open screen, and folding keeps your place. Everything stays on the phone with no account, ads or analytics, plus JSON backup, home-screen widgets and screenshot tests that render every screen.
